g.title: TF_SOAFLOWS
g.text: When a context is specified, every operation involving an Entity like retrieving data or saving data will be executed in the specified context.
When an Agency is indicated, every Code will be converted to/from the equivalent code available for the selected Agency, depending if the flow is Outbound or Inbound.
